offering_description.value: Peloton sells connected exercise equipment and fitness memberships to consumers, and supplies commercial fitness equipment to gyms, hotels, and other facilities. It develops its workout software and produces instructor-led classes that members stream on connected equipment or through its app.

primary_products.value: Connected exercise bikes; treadmills; rowing machines; fitness accessories; commercial cardio and strength equipment

primary_services.value: Live and on-demand fitness classes; guided workout programs; in-person studio classes

customer_segment.value: B2C: Home exercisers and fitness app members; B2B: Gyms, hotels, multifamily housing operators, and corporate fitness facilities

end_markets.value: Home fitness; digital fitness; health clubs; hospitality; residential and workplace fitness amenities

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring memberships for connected equipment and app-based workouts; product sales: Home exercise equipment, accessories, and commercial fitness equipment; service fees: Admission to in-person studio classes

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Designs connected exercise equipment made by manufacturing partners for home users; software / platform: Combines instructor-led content with workout software for home users and app members; OEM / manufacturer: Builds commercial cardio and strength equipment for gyms and other facilities; service provider: Uses instructors and studios to deliver live and recorded classes to members
value_chain_position.category: brand owner; software / platform; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Germany, and Australia, with wider international distribution of commercial equipment

specialization.value: related lines: Home exercise equipment, digital fitness memberships, and commercial cardio and strength equipment

distribution_channels.value: online: Company website and mobile app; third-party retail: Online marketplaces and sporting goods retailers; direct sales: Commercial sales teams serving gyms, hotels, and other facilities; distributors / dealers: Commercial fitness equipment dealers; own locations: Company-operated studios offering in-person classes
distribution_channels.category: online; third-party retail; direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Exercise equipment falls under consumer product safety oversight, and fitness apps are subject to data privacy rules.

notes: Current availability of equipment rentals is uncertain.
